description: Window filtering must be exact: [current_start, current_end) with an inclusive lower bound and exclusive upper bound. PR_801 sits exactly on current_start (included), PR_802 one second before it (excluded from current, falls into baseline), PR_803 exactly on current_end == analysis_at (excluded from current -- it hasn't existed for any duration within the window yet), and PR_804 crosses a UTC midnight rollover to catch date-only comparison bugs.

pull_requests.author: alice
pull_requests.note: created exactly AT current_start -- included in current window (inclusive lower bound)

pull_requests.author: bob
pull_requests.note: created ONE SECOND before current_start -- excluded from current window, falls into baseline instead (baseline_end is exclusive and equals current_start)

pull_requests.author: carol
pull_requests.note: created exactly AT current_end == analysis_at -- excluded from current window (exclusive upper bound); still counts in point-in-time pending_review_count with 0 days idle

pull_requests.author: dave
pull_requests.note: crosses UTC midnight between creation and merge -- catches date-only (instead of full timestamp) comparison bugs

expected.findings_rationale: No rule fires -- purpose is exact boundary placement (PR_801 in, PR_802 out to baseline, PR_803 out of both windows entirely) and correct sub-day arithmetic across a UTC midnight (PR_804), not a finding.
